notes.title: Frightened Great Graveyard update is here!
notes.content:
Hello dear Frightened players.

A new update for Frightened is at the door; After a long break, Frightened returns with the Graveyard Map. Our map; It tells a chain of events that occur after a mistake made by the Paradise company. In this map, you can discover the secret cellar; You will experience fearful moments.

I Give You the Recipe for Winning
1- We are collecting the babies, but be careful, they are a little fickle :)
2- We purify the babies we collected on the purification platform downstairs.
3- We go to church and cremate our baby beautifully.

AAAA But he is angry now, what should I do?
It's simple, actually, you leave the church door and go straight, you donate a cross to the woman in front of you and she takes care of everything for you.

Some Things That Have Changed in the New Map
-Actually, the monster block system that we willingly added is no longer on this map, monsters will now continue their way through you.
-The monsters in the game will no longer get angry immediately, you will start the game with a mercy period of 6.5 minutes. If you perform the baby ritual within 6.5 minutes, the time will be erased and the spells holding the monsters will be broken and they will begin to haunt you.
-Monster running speeds have changed, they are faster than before 🙂

Good games already. -Entry Studios Team

notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE
notes.content:
Yo yo yo, it's MaviDavsan here! I'm excited to share with you some features we've added to Frightened, inspired by your valuable feedback as players and recommendations from our awesome streamer friends.

-We have changed the color palette of the game atmosphere to be more visually appealing.

-An in-game assistant has been included.

-We've given the lobby interface a refresh, making it more user-friendly.

-AI improvements have been implemented (ongoing work to make them even better).

-The catch rate for rats has been increased. Old: 60% - 40% New: 75% - 25%

-The hologram of the creature is less aggressive.

-The vision of fallen players now turns red.

-And we have fixed some bugs.

We will continue to work as hard as we can to provide you with a better gaming experience. You can support us by providing feedback through our Discord server or by leaving reviews of our game.

                                                        From the Frightened development team      - MaviDavsan
